title.zh: FinCEN 放弃加密货币钱包与混币器规则提案
title.en: FinCEN Drops Crypto Wallet and Mixer Rule Proposals

current_state.zh: FinCEN has dropped its long-standing proposed cryptocurrency wallet rule, easing regulatory pressure on self-hosted wallet users and the broader crypto industry.
current_state.en: FinCEN has dropped its long-standing proposed cryptocurrency wallet rule, easing regulatory pressure on self-hosted wallet users and the broader crypto industry.

updates.title_zh: DOJ Presses Roman Storm Case as FinCEN Drops Mixer Proposal
updates.title_en: DOJ Presses Roman Storm Case as FinCEN Drops Mixer Proposal
updates.what_changed_zh: The DOJ filed a new motion contesting Roman Storm's venue challenge in the Tornado Cash prosecution while FinCEN dropped its mixer rule proposal, with Storm's acquittal motion still pending and a retrial scheduled for April 26, 2027.
